# Third-party source

`libldac/` is the Sony LDAC encoder source used for the included DLL.
Source snapshot: https://github.com/YoshKoz/LDACast/tree/b0322ef71409e3aebabf21d5278bfbbafc219b75/third_party/ldacBT/libldac
Upstream: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/external/libldac/
License: Apache-2.0; original LICENSE and NOTICE are preserved.
Only this encoder is used; LDACast's BTstack and USB transport are not included.
